state.task: Audit the existing operator guide and propose a reorganization so first-time readers can complete setup before encountering the full parameter reference. Preserve every fact, table and command; do not edit documents.

artifacts.content:
# Operator guide
CACHE_TTL: seconds before eviction; default 60.
To begin, create config.toml.
| Option | Default |
| workers | 4 |
Run service start after saving config.toml.
CACHE_SIZE: maximum entries; default 5000.
First install the service package.

project-knowledge:doc-humanizer.instructions: Does the requested task assess or reorganize the structure of existing technical documents for their readers while preserving facts, examples, tables and voice?

criteria.false: The task neither assesses nor reorganizes existing technical-document structure; prose voice, factual drift alone, and original authorship do not qualify.
criteria.true: The task assesses or improves existing technical-document organization, navigation, hierarchy, diagrams, jargon explanation, or progressive disclosure without changing underlying facts or voice.
